StudyDocument.title: StudyDocument
StudyDocument.description: Metadata for a study material document uploaded under one of the six Darbar subjects. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

subjectId.description: Subject identifier the document belongs to.

description.description: Optional short description of the study material (0-500 characters).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

fileSizeBytes.description: Raw file size in bytes (1 to 8388608).

chunkCount.description: Number of Base64 chunks stored in the chunks subcollection (1 to 20).

uploadComplete.description: True once all file chunks have been committed.

visibility.description: Shared visibility level for all students.

uploaderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the uploader.

uploaderName.description: Display name of the uploader (no PII).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of document upload creation (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FileChunk.title: FileChunk
FileChunk.description: A Base64-encoded binary slice of an uploaded study document stored in Firestore so any student on any device can preview and download the file.

uploaderId.description: Denormalized Firebase Auth UID of the parent document uploader.

DailyQuiz.title: DailyQuiz
DailyQuiz.description: AI-generated 10-question General Knowledge daily quiz shared across all students for a specific YYYY-MM-DD date.

dateKey.description: ISO date key YYYY-MM-DD matching the document ID.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user whose session generated today's quiz.

questions.description: Exactly 10 multiple-choice General Knowledge questions with 4 options, correctIndex, explanation, and topic.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of daily quiz generation (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Personal record of a student's daily quiz attempt, score, and chosen answers.

dateKey.description: ISO date key YYYY-MM-DD of the attempted quiz.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the attempt (1-10).

selectedAnswers.description: List of selected option indices per question.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest attempt update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/documents/{documentId}.description: Shared study materials categorized by subjectId for all authenticated Darbar students.

/documents/{documentId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked Base64 binary slices for each study document enabling permanent cross-device preview and download.

/daily_quizzes/{dateKey}.description: Once-per-day Gemini-generated General Knowledge quiz keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.

/users/{userId}/quiz_attempts/{dateKey}.description: Private per-student daily quiz score and answer history.
